Do you thrive on turning ambitious digital strategies into measurable business impact? Are you ready to be a trusted advisor to some of Denmark's leading brands? If so, you may be the Senior Management Consultant we're looking for to join our Consulting team in Aarhus or Copenhagen.

At Novicell, we help companies unlock their full digital potential. We combine creative thinking, technical expertise with strategic innovation to deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business results. Our diverse team of specialists works with a shared ambition: to create outstanding customer experiences, enable growth, and push what digital can do.

**Your Responsibilities

**As a Senior Management Consultant, you will join our consulting team with a clear mandate: build strong client partnerships and position Novicell as a trusted advisor for ambitious B2C and B2B brands in Denmark and beyond. From day one, you will be responsible for shaping strategies, driving growth, and delivering impact.

**Your role will include:

**

• Designing digital strategies and roadmaps that turn client ambitions into measurable business results.

• Structuring and facilitating strategic processes for large-scale digital projects - from initial discovery to project governance and delivery models.

• Driving pitch processes and winning new business through compelling proposals, business cases, and C-level presentations.

• Acting as a trusted advisor to digital leaders, guiding executives and stakeholders with clarity and confidence.

• Translating business needs and strategic goals into digital solutions that deliver growth.

• Contributing to building and strengthening Novicell’s internal expertise across our offices.

**Your profile

**You are commercially minded, strategically sharp, and digitally fluent. With a natural drive and a can-do mindset, you thrive on solving complex challenges, balancing strategic thinking with hands-on delivery. Ideally, you bring experience from management consulting, internal consulting or digital advisory, with a proven track record of advising senior stakeholders.

**We imagine you bring:

**

• + 3 years of experience in consulting, digital business development, or e-commerce strategy.

• A strong business understanding and the ability to structure and analyze complex challenges.

• Demonstrated experience leading pitches, workshops, and strategic dialogues with C-level stakeholders.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and high standards for quality.

• The ability to build strong relationships and inspire trust with clients and colleagues alike.

• Curiosity and a continuous drive to learn and develop.

• Fluency in Danish and English, spoken and written.

**What We Offer

**At Novicell, you will step into an ambitious and professional environment where you can make a real impact. As Senior Management Consultant, you will report directly to our Consulting Director and play a central role in advising some of the most exciting brands in Denmark and abroad.

**We offer:

**

• Challenging and impactful projects from day one.

• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal growth.

• Inspiring colleagues who bring expertise and ambition to every collaboration.

• A collaborative culture built on our motto “Flink & Flittig” – professionalism, helpfulness, and dedication in everything we do.

• Freedom and flexibility to shape your workday.

• A strong social culture with activities and events across offices.

**Life at Novicell

**At Novicell, we believe job satisfaction and dedication go hand in hand. Our motto “Flink & Flittig” reflects our core values of professionalism and collaboration. We value openness, trust, and shared responsibility over rigid rules. We believe that joy at work is the key to motivation, creativity, and strong teamwork.

**You will experience:

**

• An informal organization with significant personal freedom.

• A dedicated focus on professional excellence and continued learning.

• A vibrant social culture with many activities and events.

• Some of the friendliest and most dedicated colleagues in the industry.

**Practical details

**

• Location: Copenhagen or Aarhus.

• Applications are welcome in English or Danish.

• We review applications continuously and will close the process once the right candidate is found.

• If you have any questions, please contact Minho Vorre at meg@novicell.dk

We look forward to receiving your application!

Read more about Novicell here

**Who We Are

**For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, educations, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the mergers with Axioma and Domos, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**Our Market Units are where SimCorp meets its clients – and the commercial engine behind them is what turns strategy into growth. As Head of Global Commercial, you will lead the global commercial organisation that powers our front-line Market Unit teams, including Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing.

Reporting to Oliver Johnson, Chief Revenue Officer, and working as a peer to our regional Managing Directors, you will lead a commercial transformation with a clear top-line focus: making our Market Units more effective, more productive and better equipped to win. The role is based in EMEA – in London, Copenhagen or Frankfurt.

Success in this role means Market Units that spend more of their time with clients, a commercial organisation where AI and data are part of how every team works, and a commercial model that scales with SimCorp’s growth.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**

• Commercial transformation: Define and lead a transformation agenda that makes SimCorp’s Market Units across all regions more efficient, scalable and growth-oriented

• Commercial organisation: Lead and develop Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and Marketing, ensuring each function directly supports front-line performance

• Top-line growth: Improve pipeline generation, sales productivity, win rates and deal velocity across the Market Units

• Operating model: Review and optimise the commercial team set-up and operating model, so people, resources and investment are focused on the highest-impact growth opportunities

• AI and data: Embed AI, automation and data-driven insight into commercial processes – from forecasting and territory planning to enablement and marketing execution

• Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with the Chief Revenue Officer, partner with regional Managing Directors and Market Unit leaders, and establish a commercial cadence and KPIs that give leadership clear transparency on performance

**What We Value

**Most importantly, you can see yourself contributing and thriving in the position described above. How you gained the skills needed for doing that is less important. We expect you to be good at several of the following and be able to - and interested in - learning the rest:

• Experience leading a commercial team transformation end-to-end, with measurable improvements in productivity and growth

• Significant experience driving commercial performance and value creation; scaled experience in Financial Services, Private Equity or Software

• Deep knowledge of financial services and the investment management software market, including the buy-side client landscape, market dynamics and competitors

• Senior leadership of commercial functions such as Revenue Operations, Sales Enablement and/or Marketing, across multiple regions and cultures

• An AI-native mindset, with hands-on experience applying AI, automation and modern go-to-market tooling to commercial teams

• Leadership that builds and inspires high-performing teams, makes difficult decisions with clarity and empathy, and influences senior stakeholders in a matrix organisation

**NEXT STEPS

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For any questions you are welcome to contact Michael Paterson, Talent Acquisition Partner, at MLPN@SimCorp.com . If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.

We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

SimCorp is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

jobs.description:
At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

Genmab is seeking an experienced (Senior) Clinical Drug Supply Manager to join Global Clinical Drug Supply (GCDS) Manufacturing in Copenhagen.

The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in ensuring the timely delivery of high-quality clinical trial supplies for both early and late-stage trials. In addition, this position offers significant influence over the refinement of Genmab’s processes, both within the GCDS Manufacturing function and cross-functionally to ensure scalability.

The (Senior) Clinical Drug Supply Manager will resolve complex operational challenges, lead strategic initiatives and mentor colleagues. A key focus of this role will be supporting team members through troubleshooting, problem-solving, and developing mitigation plans for complex issues related to packaging and labelling activities. This role requires balancing urgency and importance in a dynamic environment while serving as a positive role model for the team, by bringing a strong can-do attitude to drive solutions and inspire others.

The position reports to the Associate Director, Team Lead, Global Clinical Drug Supply Manufacturing based in Princeton.

**Responsibilities

**Responsibilities will be adjusted based on level of experience, and may include the following:

• Manage operational trial and project objectives related to packaging and labelling, providing proactive oversight to meet goals.

• Oversee inspection readiness and ensure compliance with relevant GMP, GDP and GCP regulations.

• Engage with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment and successful collaboration.

• Supervise and monitor vendor performance, ensuring delivery aligns with timelines and SOW.

• Provide direct support to team members in troubleshooting and problem resolution, ensuring effective development of mitigation plans for operational challenges.

• Mentor and coach team members, fostering a collaborative and high-performing environment.

• Lead complex GCDS Manufacturing projects within the area of clinical drug supply management.

• Develop, maintain and implement SOPs for drug supply processes and manage cross-functional collaborations.

**Qualifications

**

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant area (e.g., pharma, science, engineering, or supply chain management).

• Minimum 3 years of experience at manager level, and minimum 6+ years’ experience for Senior Manager. Ideally demonstrated skills with global CMO vendor collaboration and oversight of clinical packaging and labelling activities.

• Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional projects with an innovative and entrepreneurial mindset.

• Collaborative, proactive, and goal-oriented team player who inspires colleagues while fostering strong relationships.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Extensive knowledge of GMP, GDP, and GCP regulations.

• Excellent communication skills in English, both oral and written.

**The Team

**You will join a highly competent team focused on packaging and labelling clinical trial supplies, collaborating closely with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Execution team. Together with the Global Clinical Drug Supply Systems team and Global Clinical Drug Supply Strategy team, these four functions form the Global Clinical Drug Supply department. We foster a supportive, international, and fast-paced work environment centered on collaboration, excellence, and a can-do attitude to achieve results.

**Application

**If this opportunity excites you, we encourage you to upload your CV and cover letter outlining your motivation for the position. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis, and interviews will be scheduled accordingly. Please note, fully remote applicants will not be considered; candidates must be within commuting distance of Copenhagen.

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK687.888,00---1.031.832,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

**In this Director of Legal role, you’ll be…

**

• Serving as the legal partner to Sales by driving commercial SaaS contracting, handling T&Cs, MSAs, and DPAs, negotiating deviations, and maintaining fallback negotiation playbooks.

• Managing corporate legal matters, including entity management across international markets, governance, board support, and selective coordination with external counsel.

• Supporting the company's compliance framework in close partnership with our existing Compliance function, with a path toward taking over internal compliance ownership in the near future.

• Owning vendor and supplier contracting by reviewing and negotiating key terms on liability, security, privacy, and SLAs alongside Finance and Operations.

• Building and scaling a lean legal operating model by proactively driving processes, internal guidance, and review triggers to keep legal operations efficient.

• Supporting fundraising rounds, corporate structuring, and M&A initiatives in close collaboration with the CFO and leadership team.

**Who is the Legal Team?

**Sitting within Finance & Operations, the Legal function drives our overall legal direction while remaining hands-on in building a scalable framework that supports our rapid growth across European markets. We safeguard the company across commercial SaaS contracting, corporate law, international scaling, and vendor management, while supporting future fundraising and M&A activities.

We act as a close partner to executive stakeholders, Sales, Finance, and Security, balancing fast risk-reward decisions with robust corporate governance. You will work directly with the Chief Financial Officer and lead our Corporate Lawyer in an environment that values extreme ownership, pragmatic decision-making, and strong cross-functional collaboration to enable business velocity.

Essentially, we contribute to our vision by protecting the business and providing the legal backbone needed to scale our platform across international markets safely and efficiently.

**What you’ll bring:

**

• Ideally, +5-10 years of relevant legal experience in a similar role, with proven exposure to a fast-growing SaaS environment that has scaled internationally.

• A hands-on, autonomous mindset with the drive to take full ownership of the legal function and scale it from the current setup.

• Strong expertise in commercial SaaS contracting and negotiating client-facing terms.

• GDPR and data privacy expertise, with experience maintaining compliance frameworks.

• Experience with corporate law and governance (board and shareholder matters, entity management), plus exposure to fundraising and M&A processes alongside external counsel.

• A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset with a strong grasp of risk-reward balance to keep sales velocity high while protecting the business.

• Excellent communication and negotiation skills, with fluency in English (Danish is not a requirement).

**What do we offer you?

**

• A starting salary of 115,000 DKK per month. As you grow within this role, your compensation can grow with you up to 130,000 DKK per month.

• Continuous development through a clear and transparent framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through bi-annual growth talks and regular check-ins.

• Thorough pre- and onboarding to set you up for success.

• An office-first culture in a centrally located office near Kødbyen, along with visa and relocation support if needed.

• A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.

• A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.

• Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company meets and connects.

**Our recruitment process

**

• 30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition Partner

• 30-minute online interview with our CFO

• Completion of Personality Assessment & Case Presentation

• 60-minute in-person final case interview with our CFO & other relevant stakeholders

• Cultural interview with relevant stakeholders across the organisation

**About Formalize

**Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid, Munich & Paris. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from +30 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest-growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We celebrate our wins, learn from our mistakes, and grow together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation for our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy. Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

****Ready to apply?

****We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

Do you want to be a valued part of the critical infrastructure that serves communities across Europe and beyond? Are you looking for an opportunity where you can make an impact, shape decisions, and accelerate your career?

If so, we are looking for dedicated, curious, and highly motivated graduates to join the DFDS Graduate Programme starting in September 2027.

Be part of the movement - and play your part.  **About The Finance Graduate Programme

**The DFDS Graduate Programme is a two-year fast-track programme for recent graduates with an interest in and passion for the maritime industry. With several acquisitions and continued growth across Europe, our Finance Division plays a key role in supporting business performance, driving strategic decision-making, and enabling sustainable growth across DFDS.

During the programme, you will complete three rotations across different areas of our Finance Division. You will begin at our headquarters in Copenhagen, followed by a mandatory international rotation at one of our European hubs. Your final rotation at our headquarters (HQ) will be tailored to your skills, interests, and our business needs.

Throughout the programme, you will gain broad exposure to both the business partnering and HQ functions of our Finance Division while building valuable industry knowledge and professional experience.

**Finance at DFDS

**Finance is at the heart of supporting our business and helping DFDS make informed decisions across our shipping and logistics operations.

**Examples Of Interesting Tasks Could Be

**

• Support business performance analysis and partner with stakeholders across functions and markets.

• Contribute to forecasting and planning processes, helping identify opportunities and areas requiring further analysis.

• Work with financial reporting, consolidation, accounting, and performance management.

• Develop KPI reporting and management insights to support business decisions.

• Deliver analyses and recommendations to management, highlighting performance trends, risks, and opportunities.

• Gain exposure to strategic projects, investments, and initiatives supporting the continued growth of DFDS.

Across all rotations, you will work closely with highly skilled colleagues and collaborate with teams across our business units, group functions, and senior leadership. To support your development, each rotation will include both a dedicated manager and a mentor who will help you successfully navigate your learning journey.

**About You

**At DFDS, we believe the strongest teams are built on diversity, inclusion, and different perspectives. We are looking for candidates who:

• Have graduated from a relevant master’s degree by the start of the Graduate Programme in September 2027.

• Have gained relevant experience through a student job, internship, exchange programme, or other extracurricular activities.

• Have no more than two years of full-time professional experience after completing your master's degree.

• Demonstrate strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Are collaborative team players who enjoy working with others and creating impact.

• Are curious, proactive, and eager to learn and develop professionally.

• Have an international mindset and are excited about working across cultures and locations.

Working at DFDS **Join the movement and grow with us.

**As part of the DFDS Graduate Programme, you will become part of a strong graduate network across the company and build valuable connections across our international business. We offer a steep learning curve, meaningful responsibility from day one, and three interesting rotations designed to accelerate your professional development.

Are we a match? Apply now.  If your skills, experience, aspirations, and personality match this opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

Please Apply By Uploading Your CV No Later Than 30 November 2026. When Applying, You’re Also Asked To Answer The Following Questions

• Why are you interested in joining the DFDS Graduate Programme?

• How will the programme help kickstart your career?

• How do you expect to contribute to the programme and DFDS?

• What do you believe will be your biggest challenge(s) during the programme?

**We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management
jobs.description:
Drive meaningful impact across the life sciences industry.

As our next Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will contribute to solving meaningful challenges across the life sciences industry. We offer specialised management consulting services, working with top-tier life sciences companies as well as biotech startups -locally and globally. From strategy development to hands-on implementation, we support our clients were impact matters most.

About the role

As a Manager - Business Advisory and Project Management, you will work closely with clients and colleagues to address complex challenges across the life sciences value chain. You will take ownership of your work and contribute to delivering solutions that create real, lasting impact. This is a Senior role designed to provide project and program leadership to deliver strategic technical solutions that address complex client issues in the Life Sciences industry. You will be handling implementation/migration projects and programs to achieve desired outcomes and ensure successful business growth. You will also seek new business opportunities to help BASE life science grow its presence within existing and new customers.

Additionally, you will contribute to internal initiatives and training to further strengthen BASE life science’s project and program management methodologies, approach, and tools.

You will lead teams consisting of multiple workstreams, which could include BASE/Infosys, external third party, or client stakeholders. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in, project/program management and the ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.

Your responsibilities include:

• Developing responses to Requests for Proposals (RfPs), ensuring adequate planning for scope, timelines and budget

• Monitoring project/program status including milestones, risks, issues, budgets, etc.

• Acting as a delivery escalation point and proactively ensuring escalations are handled promptly with a clear action and communication plan.

• Creating and delivering tailored communication based on audience, i.e., executive level summaries for client stakeholders, or senior executives in BASE life science, status reports at a project or program-level at a suitable cadence for team members

• Intervening, when necessary, to ensure costs, timelines and quality are on track.

• Lead a cross-functional team to deliver projects/programs to the required scope, on time, within budget, and to the satisfaction of our life science industry stakeholders.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders in the life science industry to understand their needs and translate them into executable plans for the project team.

• Develop plans, timelines, and budgets for projects/programs for which you are responsible.

• Track and report on project/program progress, identifying and mitigating risks as needed.

• Facilitate communication and collaboration between the project team, life science industry stakeholders, and other teams within BASE life science.

You bring:

• 5+ years of experience as a technical project/program manager within Regulatory, Clinical, Quality or other GxP areas in the life science industry.

• Successful track record of managing technically complex projects/programs such as software development, implementation of IT systems, data migrations, etc.

• Experience leading technical teams and delivering data driven projects/programs.

• Experience with project management tools such as JIRA, Smartsheet, Microsoft Project etc.

• Experience with Agile project management methodologies such as SAFe.

• Strong communication skills, both in writing, meetings and in presentations.

• Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.

Additionally, the ideal candidate has the following skills/certifications:

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

• Experience selling either projects or products to clients.

• Experience working with Veeva Vault, SalesForce or similar technologies.

• Experience working with AI professionally

This position is offered in Denmark and Spain.

Who is BASE life science?

Founded in 2015, BASE life science is a business and technology consulting company working exclusively in life sciences, built on a simple purpose: grow our people, and deliver real impact for our customers.

We don't think AI is a feature you bolt onto existing systems — we think it's the layer through which a life sciences company's strategy actually gets executed, end to end. Most of the industry is still proving AI can do one task at a time, function by function, pilot by pilot. We're building toward something bigger: AI that runs across clinical, regulatory, quality, and commercial work instead of stopping at the edges of a single application.

With headquarters in Denmark and offices across Spain, Switzerland, the UK, Germany, France, Italy, and the US, we work with top-10 pharma and ambitious biotechs alike, and with technology partners including Veeva, Salesforce, IQVIA, Google, AWS, Microsoft, and Amass — turning that belief into deployed, compliant, sellable solutions, not slideware.

Why join BASE Life Science?

At BASE, you work on meaningful, complex challenges at the intersection of technology, science, and business. We trust our people with real responsibility and support them in turning ambition into impact — grounded in five core values: team spirit, trust, openness, ambition, and execution.

• Ambition, encouraged through ownership and continuous learning.

• Execution — we focus on delivering solutions that work in practice.

• Openness — your ideas are heard, challenged constructively, and supported as you grow.

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance.

• The opportunity to shape a practice, not just staff one.

Alongside this, we offer:

• Support for health and wellbeing, covering physical, mental, and social needs

• Flexible ways of working, built on trust, autonomy, and balance

• Ongoing learning and professional development throughout your career

• A modern work setup, with the tools and equipment needed to do great work

• Recognition of performance and impact, linked to contribution and results

• The opportunity to work on challenges that make a meaningful difference for patients and healthcare systems worldwide

Explore our work, values, and people at www.baselifescience.com

Interested?

If you find this position intriguing, don't delay—submit your application in English at your earliest convenience. We are continuously reviewing and assessing all incoming candidates and eagerly await your application.

At BASE Life Science, we value diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. Employment decisions are based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs

• Deliver in production : Ship your own changes through our CI/CD pipelines and watch how they behave once live.

• First three months: you ship small customer-facing changes to production with review support, you can explain the plan-change and invoicing paths in your own words, and you ask for help before you are stuck for a day.

• Growth mindset: You treat skill as something built, not fixed, and you go looking for feedback.

• Team player: You contribute to a collaborative team and are comfortable working closely with QA, UX and Product.

We are looking for a Financial Controller to lead the operational and analytical work behind our monthly close, group consolidation, project controlling and control environment of a fast-growing energy trading and technology group – and to rebuild them AI-first, so our numbers are faster, more reliable and ready for scale.

Why this role matters

Hybrid Greentech is scaling fast as a VPP, BRP and electricity retailer across Denmark, and Northern Europe. Energy trading means large and volatile daily revenue, cost and cash transactions – so quality , accuracy and liquidity control are not back-office topics; they decide how fast we can grow. This role exists to give management, the board and investors numbers they can trust, on time, and to build controls and automation that scale with the business rather than with headcount. The same discipline is needed in our consultancy arm, where technical consultants deliver advisory and EPC management projects: clear project economics, timely invoicing and early warning when a project drifts.

The role

As Financial Controller, you report to our Finance Manager and work closely with the CFO and our accountant in a small, hands-on finance team. You lead the operational and analytical work within the financial steering, reporting and finance and business analytics; running the month-end close, the consolidation of our group entities in Denmark and abroad, balance sheet reconciliations, project controlling and the day-to-day operation of our internal controls. This is an individual contributor role with high ownership and direct visibility towards management.

You will work in close collaboration with our settlement team, project managers and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting, partner with our accountant on more complex accounting topics, and work across trading, portfolio management, commercial and engineering. We are a tech-first company with high AI adoption, and we expect you to work that way too: AI tools, scripting and automation are your default approach to removing manual work from close, reconciliation and reporting – combined with the judgement to know when a number needs a human review.

What you will do

• Lead and execute the monthly close and group consolidation, including account mapping, intercompany eliminations, reconciliations and variance analysis, and prepare the monthly financial and business review for the CFO, management and the board.

• Set up and run project controlling – project budgets, hours and utilisation, work in progress, milestone and fixed-fee revenue recognition and timely invoicing – giving project managers and business owners clear steering on margin, estimate-to-complete and cash.

• Automate and rebuild our reporting flow – from ERP trial balances to consolidated P&L, balance sheet and cash flow – using AI tools, scripting and data pipelines, replacing manual spreadsheet steps with controlled, repeatable and documented processes.

• Operate and strengthen our internal controls within the framework set by the Finance Manager, including segregation of duties, payment and bank authorisations and documented business procedures, and drive follow-up on auditor recommendations.

• In close collaboration with Settlement, ensure trading-related balances – settlement, imbalance costs, customer prepayments and deposits, and collateral posted to TSOs, DSOs and exchanges – are correctly recognized, invoiced and reconciled

• Support cash and liquidity forecasting and management with the Finance Manager and CFO, including rolling cash forecasts, collateral and trading risk capital tracking, and early warning on cash exposure.

• Prepare and analyse the annual budget and monthly forecast updates for the Finance Manager and CFO, maintaining our driver-based budget model and following up on budget-versus-actual deviations with business owners.

• Handle key accounting areas such as revenue recognition and accruals, capitalisation of development projects, grant periodisation and month-end cost accruals, collaborating with our accountant on more complex accounting topics.

• Support in the year-end close and audit for all group entities, including annual reports, tax specifications and intercompany agreements, in close collaboration with Finance Manager and our external auditors.

• Work closely with our Settlement team and business owners to ensure adequate financial steering and reporting – turning data into insight on gross profit by revenue stream, cost of execution and unit economics, and building dashboards that let the business self-serve.

What you bring

Experience and skills (Required)

• 5+ years of experience as a controller, in audit or in a group finance role, ideally in a multi-entity set-up.

• A relevant degree in accounting, finance or economics (e.g. cand.merc., HD-R or cand.merc.aud.).

• Proven hands-on experience running month-end close, consolidation and year-end audit under the Danish Financial Statements Act (Årsregnskabsloven)

• Hands-on experience with ERP systems, preferably e-conomic

• Solid understanding of balance sheet accounting, revenue recognition, capitalised development costs, accruals and intercompany transactions.

• Experience with project controlling – budgets, work in progress, utilisation and project margin follow-up – ideally in a consultancy, engineering, Trading or EPC business.

• A genuine AI-first way of working: you use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or Copilot daily and can show concrete examples of finance processes you have automated (e.g. with Python, SQL, Power Query, APIs or low-code tools).

• Strong Excel and financial modelling skills combined with a structured, control-minded approach and high attention to detail.

• The ability to work independently in a fast-paced scale-up, prioritise under pressure and explain financial matters clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Language: English (required); Danish

Nice to have

• Experience from energy trading, utilities, commodities or financial services – e.g. settlement, collateral, imbalance or margin processes.

• Experience with e-conomic, time registration or PSA tools, ERP migration to a more scalable platform, and BI tools such as Power BI.

• Experience with public grant-funded projects, transfer pricing or building internal controls in a growth company.

• A background from a Big 4 or mid-tier audit firm.

What we offer

• Real responsibility: the chance to improve how close, controls and reporting are run in a scaling energy trading group – not just maintain them.

• An AI-first workplace where you get the tools and the mandate to automate, experiment and rethink how finance is done, working closely with our CFO, trading and tech teams with exposure to board and investor reporting.

• Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.

• A collaborative environment with short decision lines, high trust, and strong cross-functional execution.

• The opportunity to work with forward-looking customers and partners driving electrification and the green transition in Northern Europe.

Ready to apply?

Ready to build an AI-first finance function for a company where every megawatt-hour traded must be settled, reconciled and controlled? If you combine accounting rigour with a builder's mindset, we would love to hear from you.

Deadline

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until 10 December. We reserve the right to close this vacancy earlier if a suitable candidate is identified and accepted.

About Hybrid Greentech

Hybrid Greentech helps Battery Energy Storage Systems and flexible assets perform across their full lifecycle, from project readiness to real-time multi-market trading. We are a vertically integrated VPP, BRP and retailer. We combine analytics, EPC management, asset integration and automated trading to turn flexibility into reliable value for the grid and for asset owners. We are a diverse, international team of 45+ based in Høje Taastrup, building technology that makes 100% renewable energy workable in practice.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Strategy Manager at atNorth

**Are you passionate about building strategy?

We are looking for a Strategy Manager to help define and drive atNorth's future growth and strategic direction. This is a highly visible role working closely with the CEO, Executive Committee, Board, and senior business leaders to identify opportunities, solve complex business challenges, and ensure atNorth remains at the forefront of the rapidly evolving Nordic data center market.

Focusing heavily on strategy development, you will lead analyses, challenge assumptions, identify opportunities, and develop recommendations that influence critical decisions across growth, power, sustainability, commercial development, and corporate strategy. Reporting to the Director of Strategy and working as part of our Strategy team, you will collaborate closely with our existing Strategy Manager, combining strategic thinking with practical execution to turn ambitious goals into tangible outcomes.

This is a unique opportunity to influence the direction of one of the fastest-growing data center platforms in the Nordics. You will have direct exposure to executive leadership and play a key role in decisions that shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure across the region. You'll join a collaborative, international team where curiosity, ownership, and impact are valued, and where your work will directly contribute to atNorth's continued success.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Lead the development and refinement of atNorth's corporate strategy, ensuring alignment with long-term business objectives.

• Keep a pulse on market trends, customer demand, competitor activity, technology developments, and broader industry dynamics to identify risks and opportunities.

• Translate market insights and business intelligence into strategic recommendations that support growth, competitiveness, and long-term value creation.

• Partner with executives, business leaders, and functional teams to evaluate strategic initiatives and priorities across the organisation.

• Support strategic planning, decision-making, and Board preparation activities alongside the Executive Committee and senior leadership team.

• Lead strategic projects and cross-functional initiatives from concept through implementation.

• Develop compelling business cases, market assessments, and strategic presentations for senior stakeholders.

• Support the development of power, sustainability, commercial, and geographic growth strategies that are critical to atNorth's long-term success.

• Engage with internal and external stakeholders to gather insights that inform strategic planning and decision-making.

• Act as a trusted advisor and thought partner to senior leadership on strategic opportunities and challenges.

**Your profile:

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Economics, Engineering, Strategy, Industrial Management, or a related field.

• 5+ years of experience in corporate strategy, management consulting, business development, strategic planning, or related disciplines.

• Demonstrated experience developing business strategies and influencing strategic decisions at a senior level.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to turn complex information into actionable recommendations.

• Experience presenting to executive leadership teams, boards, or senior decision-makers.

• Excellent stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence without direct authority.

• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to engage audiences ranging from operational teams to executives.

• Professional proficiency in English.

• Experience within the data center, energy, utilities, infrastructure, technology, or other capital-intensive industries is considered a strong advantage.

**About the atNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together.
